name: SendNotification
caption: Send Notification

configuration.description: The message text (note the capital M in the key). Supports SmartFields ({{..}}), SmartFormulas ([[..]]) and SmartControls ({#..#}). Shown text is truncated to 2048 characters. Empty = the step does nothing.

0 = Notification (bar at the top of the page, appears immediately, may carry actions); 1 = Dialog message (modal, must be acknowledged; Business Central shows it only when the flow has finished and control returns to the client). Absent = 0.
Up to 3 notification actions (buttons). Only used when display = 0. Row: {label, type, target, record, recordTableNo, filters, filterTableNo, filterDisplay}.
Action type as a string ordinal: "1" = Start flow, "2" = Open card, "3" = Open list. "0"/empty/other = none (invalid).
Start flow: the Code of an active (published) manual flow. Open card / Open list: the page ID as a decimal string.
{{selector}} to a record reference. Required for Open card, and for Start flow when the target manual flow runs on a record. Cleared ("") for Open list and for record-less manual flows.
Table no. the record selector points to, computed by the editor on save; 0 = unknown (skips the table-match check).

Open list only: [{"fieldNo": <int>, "filter": <SmartText filter expression>}] on the list page's source table. Entries with fieldNo 0 or an empty filter are ignored. SmartFields in filter values are resolved and then act as filter syntax.
Open list only: the table the filters were defined for; must equal the list page's source table (0 = unknown, no check).
Display text only ('Caption: filter, ...'). Not read at run time.

rules.check: configuration.Message is a required field in the editor. Not checked at publish; at run time an empty Message shows nothing (no error).
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: display should be 0 (Notification) or 1 (Dialog message). Any other number shows a notification without actions; the editor offers only these two options.
actions, if present, should be an array; any other value is ignored (no actions, no publish warning).

When display = 0: at most 3 rows in actions (the editor cannot add more; editor status line, publish warning 'Send notification '<stepId>': <message>'). At run time only the first 3 rows that have a label, a type and a target are offered.
rules.message: A notification can carry at most %1 actions. Remove the others.

rules.check: When display = 0: every action row needs a non-empty label (editor status line and publish warning). Row problems are prefixed 'Action <n>: '; publish adds 'Send notification '<stepId>': ' in front.
When display = 0: every action row's type must be "1", "2" or "3"
Start flow rows: target must be non-empty
Start flow rows: target must be the Code of a published manual flow on this system
rules.message: The flow %1 is not an active manual flow on this system.

rules.check: Start flow rows: if the target manual flow runs on a record, record must be set
rules.message: The flow %1 runs on a record. Select the record to start it for.

rules.check: Open card / Open list rows: target must be a non-zero page ID
Open card / Open list rows: the page must exist
Open card rows: page type must be Card, Document or ListPlus
rules.message: The page %1 is not a card page. Choose a card or document page.

rules.check: Open list rows: page type must be List or Worksheet
rules.message: The page %1 is not a list page. Choose a list or worksheet page.

rules.check: Open card / Open list rows: the page must have a (non-temporary) source table
rules.message: The page %1 shows no table, so it cannot be opened on a record.

rules.check: Open card rows: record must be set
rules.message: Select the record to open the card page on.

rules.check: Open card / Start flow rows: when recordTableNo and the expected table (page source table / manual flow table) are both known, they must be equal
rules.message: The record belongs to table %1, but table %2 is expected.

rules.check: Open list rows: when filterTableNo is non-zero it must equal the page's source table
rules.message: The filters were set for table %1, but the page %2 shows table %3. Set the filters again.

notes: Publish-time warnings are only raised when display = 0 (Notification). Each is prefixed "Send notification '<stepId>': ", and row problems additionally "Action <n>: ". Warnings ask for confirmation interactively; a headless publish (API) fails while any warning exists.
The same action rules show in the editor as the first problem on the status line (advisory, does not block saving) – listed once here with stage publish.

No run-time errors: a row that cannot be resolved (unknown flow/page, unresolvable or missing record, record of the wrong table, filter that cannot be applied, filters longer than 2000 characters as a view) is left out and logged as 'Notification action "%1" left out: %2'; the notification still goes out.

Sessions without a user interface: a Job Queue run stores the message for the user who started the run and is following it in the wait dialog (shown once the run has finished; logged as 'No user interface – the message is shown to the user following the run once it has finished.'). Any other session without UI skips it ('No user interface – notification skipped.'). Actions are not offered in those cases.
The step is offered for every trigger (no trigger restriction).

Action clicks run later, outside the flow, in the clicking user's own transaction. Records are carried by table no. + SystemId and filters as a view; if the record, page or flow is gone by then the user gets a message instead of an error. Start flow runs the manual flow with a wait dialog.
Dialog text is passed as a parameter, so % and # characters in resolved SmartFields are shown literally.
